description: Blitz fork, text-overflow: ellipsis on clipping single-line boxes (Tailwind's truncate): a line that fits is drawn whole; an overflowing line shows the glyphs that fit whole before an ellipsis, also across inline elements, the ellipsis in the box's colour. Paint only: the whole-viewport pixel gate cannot see a missing ellipsis, so screenshots of this case are inspected when Blitz changes
